$Comment: The spot the Voidtaken Horseman rides out from, in the saddle (Seasons_Of_Orbis_Voidtaken_Horseman_Mounted), on the plaza's north side of the restless graveyard. It stands in the restless graveyard's prefab as a marker entity beside the run's own entity, so every fresh copy brings a fresh one. ManualTrigger means it never spawns him on its own: only the run's boss wave (ziggfreed-common's Zc_Boss_Wave_Rise, which the run's script names this marker to) raises him, every fifth wave, and only while his last spawn is gone. RealtimeRespawn and RealtimeRespawnTime are the respawn form every marker must write; a marker that only fires on request never reads them. DeactivationDistance and DeactivationTime are wide so he is never packed back into the marker mid-fight.
